record.paper_title: Global results on rational systems in the plane, part 1
record.original_question: For the seventeen positive-parameter planar rational systems singled out in Appendix 3, determine and prove the exact boundedness character of both components for all nonnegative initial conditions with positive denominators. Here B* means the corresponding component is conjectured to be bounded for every solution, and U* means the corresponding component is conjectured to be unbounded for some parameter values and initial conditions. The systems and conjectured component behaviors are: (12,31): x_{n+1}=a1/(x_n+y_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+x_n)/(A2+y_n), conjectured (B*,B*); (23,23): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/x_n, y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n)/y_n, conjectured (U*,U*); (23,31): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/x_n, y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n)/(1+y_n), conjectured (U*,U*); (23,34): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/x_n, y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n), conjectured (U*,U*); (23,35): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/x_n, y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+x_n), conjectured (U*,B*); (23,46): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/x_n, y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n), conjectured (U*,U*); (30,30): x_{n+1}=(a1+b1 x_n)/(B1 x_n+y_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+g2 y_n)/(B2 x_n+y_n), conjectured (B*,B*); (30,31): x_{n+1}=(a1+b1 x_n)/(B1 x_n+y_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n)/(A2+y_n), conjectured (B*,B*); (30,34): x_{n+1}=(a1+b1 x_n)/(B1 x_n+y_n), y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(A2+y_n), conjectured (B*,B*); (31,31): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n)/(1+y_n), conjectured (U*,U*); (31,34): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n), conjectured (U*,U*); (31,35): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(A2+x_n), conjectured (B*,B*); (31,46): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n), conjectured (U*,U*); (34,34): x_{n+1}=(b1 x_n+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n), conjectured (U*,U*); (34,46): x_{n+1}=(b1 x_n+g1 y_n)/(A1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(A2+y_n), conjectured (U*,U*); (34,47): x_{n+1}=(b1 x_n+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(A2+x_n), conjectured (B*,B*); and (46,46): x_{n+1}=(a1+b1 x_n+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n), conjectured (U*,U*).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the following seventeen planar systems of rational difference equations of the form (x_{n+1}, y_{n+1}) = (f(x_n,y_n), g(x_n,y_n)) for n = 0,1,2,..., where all parameters a_i, b_i (β_i), g_i (γ_i), A_i, B_i are nonnegative real numbers chosen so that the right-hand sides are well defined for all admissible initial data, and where (x_0, y_0) ranges over nonnegative initial conditions for which every iterate has a positive denominator. For each system, decide and prove whether the x-component is bounded for every solution (denoted B*) or unbounded for some choice of admissible parameters and initial conditions (denoted U*), and likewise for the y-component, matching the conjectured pair shown in parentheses:

(12,31): x_{n+1}=a1/(x_n+y_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+x_n)/(A2+y_n) — (B*,B*).
(23,23): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/x_n, y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n)/y_n — (U*,U*).
(23,31): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/x_n, y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n)/(1+y_n) — (U*,U*).
(23,34): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/x_n, y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n) — (U*,U*).
(23,35): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/x_n, y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+x_n) — (U*,B*).
(23,46): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/x_n, y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n) — (U*,U*).
(30,30): x_{n+1}=(a1+b1 x_n)/(B1 x_n+y_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+g2 y_n)/(B2 x_n+y_n) — (B*,B*).
(30,31): x_{n+1}=(a1+b1 x_n)/(B1 x_n+y_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n)/(A2+y_n) — (B*,B*).
(30,34): x_{n+1}=(a1+b1 x_n)/(B1 x_n+y_n), y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(A2+y_n) — (B*,B*).
(31,31): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n)/(1+y_n) — (U*,U*).
(31,34): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n) — (U*,U*).
(31,35): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(A2+x_n) — (B*,B*).
(31,46): x_{n+1}=(a1+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n) — (U*,U*).
(34,34): x_{n+1}=(b1 x_n+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n) — (U*,U*).
(34,46): x_{n+1}=(b1 x_n+g1 y_n)/(A1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(A2+y_n) — (U*,U*).
(34,47): x_{n+1}=(b1 x_n+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(A2+x_n) — (B*,B*).
(46,46): x_{n+1}=(a1+b1 x_n+g1 y_n)/(1+x_n), y_{n+1}=(a2+b2 x_n+g2 y_n)/(1+y_n) — (U*,U*).

Establish, for each of the seventeen systems above, the precise boundedness character of both components, thereby proving (or disproving) the conjectured assignments.
artifact.status_search_result: A search for resolutions of the boundedness conjectures for these seventeen planar rational systems did not turn up a complete resolution. Subsequent literature on rational systems in the plane treats individual systems among the listed cases but no single source establishes the full set of conjectured (B*,B*)/(U*,U*) characters. The collective problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.snippet: Paper introducing the boundedness conjectures for the remaining 17 planar rational systems.
status_evidence.claim: The conjectures for the seventeen systems were posed as open problems.

status_evidence.title: Patterns of boundedness of rational systems in the plane (Camouzis, Drymonis, Ladas)
status_evidence.snippet: Subsequent work continues to list these systems among unresolved boundedness questions.
status_evidence.claim: Follow-up literature still treats these as open conjectures.
